Shun of Youyu and Yao of Taotang.

Lead all to pledge to the king.

Its blessing reaches every direction.
This body and hair of ours.
The four elements and the five constants.
Rear them with reverence.
How dare we harm them.
Women admire purity.
Men emulate talent and goodness.
Know a fault and mend it.
Do not forget what you have gained.

Do not lean on your own strengths.
